intent: Hold the open state of one hover card and tie a link to the preview card it shows on hover or keyboard focus.
typical_uses: A preview of what a link points to, such as a person's profile behind their handle
A summary of a referenced document behind a link to it

dont_use_when.situation: A short label for an icon-only control
A floating panel the user opens deliberately by clicking, or one holding controls to operate
A list of actions anchored to a trigger
Information a user needs to complete the task

instead.target: visible text on the page, or the page the link leads to
instead.note: Hovering opens the card for mouse pointers only, so touch users never see it; the link itself has to carry everything they need.

invariants.text: `open` and `defaultOpen` are both accepted; `defaultOpen` seeds the initial state and is ignored afterwards, and when `open` is given it wins and the component follows it on every render.
While open, pressing Escape or pressing outside the card closes it and reports the change through `onOpenChange`.

The root wires no ARIA relationship between trigger and card: the trigger receives no `aria-describedby`, `aria-expanded` or `aria-haspopup`, and the card no role, so assistive technology is not told that a preview exists.

children.states: children is the root's content, either React nodes or a function of the active trigger's payload that returns them
children.because: `React.ReactNode | PayloadChildRenderFunction<Payload>` - the function form receives `{ payload }` from whichever trigger opened the card. A React node and a function have no JSON Schema representation.

onOpenChange.states: onOpenChange is a callback called with the next open state and event details, not a value
onOpenChange.because: `(open: boolean, eventDetails) => void`; the second argument carries Base UI's change-event details, including the reason (such as a trigger hover or focus, an outside press or Escape). No JSON Schema type covers a function.

onOpenChangeComplete.states: onOpenChangeComplete is a callback called with the open state once the open or close animation has finished
onOpenChangeComplete.because: `(open: boolean) => void` - a function, which no JSON Schema type covers.

actionsRef.states: actionsRef is a ref the root fills with imperative `close` and `unmount` actions
actionsRef.because: `React.RefObject<PreviewCardRootActions | null>` - a ref object holding functions, which no JSON Schema type covers.

handle.states: handle is an opaque object from the primitive's PreviewCard.createHandle(), shared with a trigger placed outside this root
handle.because: `PreviewCardHandle<Payload>` is a class instance holding the card's store, not data; the kit re-exports no createHandle, so a caller imports it from the primitive.

triggerId.states: triggerId is the id of the trigger a controlled card is open for, or null
triggerId.because: `string | null` - the compiler emits one JSON type per property, so a string-or-null union is left unasserted.

defaultTriggerId.states: defaultTriggerId is the id of the trigger an initially open card is open for, or null
defaultTriggerId.because: `string | null` - the compiler emits one JSON type per property, so a string-or-null union is left unasserted.

good.title: A profile preview behind a handle
good.code:
<HoverCard>
  <HoverCardTrigger href="/users/ada">@ada</HoverCardTrigger>
  <HoverCardContent>Ada Lovelace - maintainer of the analytics engine.</HoverCardContent>
</HoverCard>

good.title: A card opened from state the caller owns
good.code:
<HoverCard open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
  <HoverCardTrigger href="/docs/spec">Specification</HoverCardTrigger>
  <HoverCardContent>The current draft, last reviewed this week.</HoverCardContent>
</HoverCard>

bad.title: A made-up openDelay prop on the root
bad.why: The root takes no delay prop; the open and close delays belong to the trigger as `delay` and `closeDelay`.
